items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: shadcn's colour and radius tokens, light and dark, for Tailwind projects without shadcn.

items.name: theme-init
items.title: Theme init
items.description: Sets the theme's class on <html> before the app starts, so a dark theme doesn't flash light.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme provider
items.description: Light, dark or the system's theme as a class on <html>, saved, and following the OS as it changes.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: A button showing the theme on screen, with a menu to choose Light, Dark or System.

items.name: use-debounced-value
items.title: useDebouncedValue
items.description: A value, once it has stopped changing for a while.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Whether a media query matches, kept up to date; useIsMobile for Tailwind's md.

items.name: use-cursor-table-params
items.title: useCursorTableParams
items.description: A server table's search, sort, page size and cursor, kept in the URL, with any router.

items.name: markdown-lite
items.title: Markdown lite
items.description: Bold, lists and paragraphs from text people type, drawn as data, never HTML.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: Markdown editor
items.description: Write and Preview tabs with a toolbar for bold and lists, an optional title, and room for your own controls.

items.name: announcement-banner
items.title: Announcement banner
items.description: A banner or notice in one of five tones, with a little Markdown, folding long text, and an optional Close.

items.name: async-multi-select
items.title: Async multi-select
items.description: Several options from a server search, as chips, with an optional All option; Escape keeps the choice.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off switch: Base UI's, with shadcn's colours.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A server-driven table: debounced search, sorting and next/previous pages, on TanStack Table.
